mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.25% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3% monthly indicate policy response to inflation, pricing in a soft landing that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3% monthly
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the return difference from baseline is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST > 1000) signal strong consumer demand for goods, supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1000 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100 (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering recessionary expectations that cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 440000 indicate robust consumer demand, fueling corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Inflationary monetary policy (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annualized and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) compresses equity valuations through rising interest rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
